clusters.name: The Verge
clusters.description: A sparse scattering of systems at the galactic rim.
detail: Settled late and loosely governed, the Verge is where fortunes are made and lost fast.
Pirate activity is common along its outer routes.

clusters.name: Hearth Cluster
clusters.description: Densely populated, heavily patrolled core systems.
detail: Seat of the old Compact government.

clusters.name: The Drift
clusters.description: A single lonely system, cut off from the trade lanes.
detail: No known routes connect the Drift to the rest of the galaxy.

clusters.name: Pistil Cluster
clusters.description: The mysterious home cluster of Vusiea. Few have ventured here.
detail: Star systems: 3 known, 2 speculated.
Access from Danswai Cloud is limited and the route is not well charted.

clusters.name: Morrison Cluster
clusters.description: A neutral cluster with occupied Future Settlers League (FSL) settlements, strategic SolPAC interests, and Iris Federation (IF) research outposts.
detail: Part of a secondary FTL Lane that connects the Local and Homestead clusters.

clusters.name: Homestead Cluster
clusters.description: All systems are under Iris Federation (IF) control, excluding the MACE-controlled Veranda system.

systems.name: Kestrel

systems.name: Oberon

systems.name: Hearthhome

systems.name: Lowlight

systems.name: Solitude

detail: Believed to be the remnant of an older, larger system.

orbitalBodies.name: Anchor I
detail: Automated mining rigs still operate here unattended.

orbitalBodies.name: Anchor Station
detail: Population ~4,000. Neutral ground for Verge traders.

orbitalBodies.name: Kestrel I
detail: Too close to the twin stars for permanent habitation.

orbitalBodies.name: Kestrel II
orbitalBodies.description: Ringed gas giant, mining platforms in orbit.
detail: Site of the corporate mining dispute.

orbitalBodies.name: Tor Belt
orbitalBodies.description: A scattered band of rock and ice.
detail: Claimed but never fully surveyed.

orbitalBodies.name: Kestrel Relay
orbitalBodies.description: An independent relay station between the belt and open space.
detail: Operated jointly by both mining corporations.

orbitalBodies.name: Watcher Probe
orbitalBodies.description: An automated survey probe holding station at the system's edge.
detail: Broadcasts telemetry to Anchor Station.

orbitalBodies.name: Boundary Marker
orbitalBodies.description: A derelict nav beacon of unknown origin.
detail: Its transponder still cycles a dead corporate ID.

orbitalBodies.name: Oberon Prime
detail: Population ~800, mostly farmers.

orbitalBodies.name: Hearthhome Capital
detail: Population ~2 million.

orbitalBodies.name: Lowlight Outpost
detail: Small permanent crew, mostly engineers.

orbitalBodies.name: The Wreck
orbitalBodies.description: The remains of a long-abandoned station.
detail: No known survivors. Origin unknown.

moons.name: Tor
moons.description: Kestrel II's largest moon, tidally locked.
detail: Home to the corporate mining camp.

moons.name: Vash
moons.description: A small, airless moon with no permanent presence.
detail: Occasionally used as a fuel depot by passing miners.

moons.name: Oberon Moon
moons.description: A tracking and relay satellite in permanent orbit around Oberon Prime.
detail: Automated, unmanned.

locations.name: Stormline Outpost
locations.description: A pressurized platform anchored in the upper cloud deck.
detail: Crew rotates every 40 days.

locations.name: Tor Camp
locations.description: The corporate mining camp on Tor's surface.
detail: Staffed year-round by contract miners.

locations.name: Cloud Mine Platform
locations.description: Harvests gas from Kestrel II's ring band.
detail: Site of the corporate mining dispute.

locations.name: Starfold Gate
locations.description: A gate marking the edge of charted space.
detail: Gateway to unsurveyed systems beyond the Verge.

locations.name: Hearthhome Shipyard
detail: Home port of the Compact fleet.

locations.name: Salvage Tether
locations.description: A jury-rigged airlock tether left by the last salvage team.
detail: No one has returned to check on it.
